messages:
sara: Quick sync — catalog launch milestone tomorrow. Need final owner handoffs for these models: zephyr-3b, ember-7b, navis-13b. Licensing check status? Perf profiles? Canary gating criteria?

devon: I ran perf on zephyr-3b. 512 tokens p95 latency 120ms on A100-80GB quantized. Need to confirm embedding shape for navis. putting numbers in staging dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/zephyr

maria: I'm still waiting on legal signoff for ember-7b (license header ambiguous). @sam?

sam: saw the doc. license looks AGPL-ish — need a CLA pass. Filing a ticket: TKT-1234. ETA EOD.

kevin: infra note — ember uses custom ops; dedicated won't support until we have wheel build. @devon can you push wheel to staging?

devon: yeah I'll pack and upload tonight. small script:
```bash
python -m build && twine upload --repository staging dist/*
```

sara: owners: @maria for ember, @devon for zephyr, @kevin for navis infra. Maria can you confirm manifest fields (quantization profile, preferred device, canary traffic %) by 4pm?

maria: on it. quick Q: navis embeddings output shape — ops team says 1024, curation expected 768. which is source of truth?

devon: model repo shows config: `hidden_size: 1024`, so embeddings 1024. If curation expects 768 we need an adapter.

maria: thanks — can we avoid adapter? downstream teams will need to change. Who owns the adapter work?

kevin: infra can host(adapter) as pre/post-processing lambda on Dedicated but it's extra latency ~8-12ms per call. tradeoff?

sara: prefer adapter in client if possible, ask product teams. For catalog, we'll ship with `emb_dim:1024` and add notice in metadata.

sam: legal done for zephyr (license MIT). Ember still blocked until TKT-1234 resolved.

maria: added metadata draft: `{ "model": "navis-13b", "embeddings_dim": "1024", "quant": "q4_n", "preferred_device": "gpu", "canary_pct": "5" }`

devon: I'll run a small regression set on zephyr+ember tonight. putting perf baseline here:
```json
{"zephyr-3b": {"p50":48, "p95":120}, "ember-7b": {"p50":86, "p95":210}}
```

sara: excellent. Last ask — canary policy: if p95 increases >20% or quality drop on eval set fails, auto-fail and rollback. Kevin can you wire threshold alert to console?

kevin: yes, will add alert rule `catalog.canary.p95_delta > 0.2` and hook to ops-signal. I'll post PR.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline triggered for zephyr canary -> pipeline/zephyr-canary-4765432101 started.

maria: timeline updated in doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/model-catalog/curation-plan #section-canary

sara: thanks everyone. owners please ack when you have files in staging. If no blockers by 16:00 PT we proceed with launch.

devon: ack — uploading wheel in 30m.

sam: ack — watching TKT-1234.

kevin: ack — PR for alerting in review.

maria: ack — metadata posted.

sara: :thumbsup: closing loop. if anything urgent ping me DM.
